notes: summary.utilized is the printed TOTAL Obligation (82,817,346.00); printed TOTAL Disbursement is 77,859,926.00 (summary.disbursed). No balance is printed, so summary.balance is null.

PAGE ORDER: in the PDF, pages 6-7 (Defibrillator, ECG Machine, Suretemp Ear Thermometer; Vital Signs Monitor, Diagnostic Sets, Mobile Exam Lights) come after the Supplemental Budget No. 2020-06 heading on page 5. Those rows are placed here in the same order as the earlier monthly reports (after Mobile BP Apparatus, section sb2020-04); the four SB 2020-06 equipment rows (pages 5 and 8) are kept together under the SB 2020-06 heading.
The SB 2020-03 heading is printed truncated: "Supplemental Budget No. 2020-03 under Ordinance".

Received amounts of completed lines were reduced to the actual cost and the unspent balances reverted as source of fund for SB No. 2020-06 (171,244 + 720,000 + 500 + 368,400 + 40 + 1,280,000 + 400 + 240 + 160 + 2,004,000 + 16 = 4,545,000.00, equal to the four SB 2020-06 items: 2,150,000 + 900,000 + 495,000 + 1,000,000).

Mobile Exam Lights: Obligation printed 460,560.00 while Received and Disbursement are 460,760.00 (verified on a 4500px re-render); the printed TOTAL Obligation 82,817,346.00 matches the sum using 460,560.00. Transcribed as printed.
